verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
verses.pt: A palavra que do Senhor veio a Jeremias, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

verses.en: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor, Deus de Israel: Escreve num livro todas as palavras que te falei;
verses.en_web: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Put down in a book all the words which I have said to you.

verses.en: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.pt: pois eis que vêm os dias, diz o Senhor, em que farei voltar do cativeiro o meu povo Israel e Judá, diz o Senhor; e tornarei a trazê-los à terra que dei a seus pais, e a possuirão.
verses.en_web: For, behold, the days come,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”
verses.en_bbe: For see, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will let the fate of my people Israel and Judah be changed, says the Lord: and I will make them come back to the land which I gave to their fathers, so that they may take it for their heritage.

verses.en: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.pt: E estas são as palavras que disse o Senhor, acerca de Israel e de Judá.
verses.en_web: These are the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the words which the Lord said about Israel and about Judah.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, diz o Senhor: Ouvimos uma voz de tremor, de temor mas não de paz.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: A voice of shaking fear has come to our ears, of fear and not of peace.

verses.en: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.pt: Perguntai, pois, e vede, se um homem pode dar à luz. Por que, pois, vejo a cada homem com as mãos sobre os lombos como a que está de parto? Por que empalideceram todos os rostos?
verses.en_web: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?
verses.en_bbe: Put the question and see if it is possible for a man to have birth-pains: why do I see every man with his hands gripping his sides, as a woman does when the pains of birth are on her, and all faces are turned green?

verses.en: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.pt: Ah! porque aquele dia é tão grande, que não houve outro semelhante! É tempo de angústia para Jacó; todavia, há de ser livre dela.
verses.en_web: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it. It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.
verses.en_bbe: Ha! for that day is so great that there is no day like it: it is the time of Jacob's trouble: but he will get salvation from it.

verses.en: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.pt: E será naquele dia, diz o Senhor dos exércitos, que eu quebrarei o jugo de sobre o seu pescoço, e romperei as suas brochas. Nunca mais se servirão dele os estrangeiros;
verses.en_web: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;
verses.en_bbe: For it will come about on that day, says the Lord of armies, that his yoke will be broken off his neck, and his bands will be burst; and men of strange lands will no longer make use of him as their servant:

verses.en: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.pt: mas ele servirá ao Senhor, seu Deus, como também a Davi, seu rei, que lhe levantarei.
verses.en_web: but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.
verses.en_bbe: But they will be servants to the Lord their God and to David their king, whom I will give back to them.

verses.en: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.pt: Não temas pois tu, servo meu, Jacó, diz o Senhor, nem te espantes, ó Israel; pois eis que te livrarei de terras longinquas, se à tua descendência da terra do seu cativeiro; e Jacó voltará, e ficará tranqüilo e sossegado, e não haverá quem o atemorize.
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.
verses.en_bbe: So have no fear, O Jacob, my servant, says the Lord; and do not be troubled, O Israel: for see, I will make you come back from far away, and your seed from the land where they are prisoners; and Jacob will come back, and will be quiet and at peace, and no one will give him cause for fear.

verses.en: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
verses.pt: Porque eu sou contigo, diz o Senhor, para te salvar; porquanto darei fim cabal a todas as nações entre as quais te espalhei; a ti, porém, não darei fim, mas castigar-te-ei com medida justa, e de maneira alguma te terei por inocente.
verses.en_web: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
verses.en_bbe: For I am with you, says the Lord, to be your saviour: for I will put an end to all the nations where I have sent you wandering, but I will not put an end to you completely: though with wise purpose I will put right your errors, and will not let you go quite without punishment.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
verses.pt: Porque assim diz o Senhor: Incurável é a tua fratura, e gravíssima a tua ferida.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord has said, Your disease may not be made well and your wound is bitter.

verses.en: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
verses.pt: Não há quem defenda a tua causa; para a tua ferida não há remédio nem cura.
verses.en_web: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
verses.en_bbe: There is no help for your wound, there is nothing to make you well.

verses.en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
verses.pt: Todos os teus amantes se esqueceram de ti; não te procuram; pois te feri com ferida de inimigo, e com castigo de quem é cruel, porque é grande a tua culpa, e têm-se multiplicado os teus pecados.
verses.en_web: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.
verses.en_bbe: Your lovers have no more thought for you, they go after you no longer; for I have given you the wound of a hater, even cruel punishment;

verses.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
verses.pt: Por que gritas por causa da tua fratura? tua dor é incurável. Por ser grande a tua culpa, e por se terem multiplicado os teus pecados, é que te fiz estas coisas.
verses.en_web: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.
verses.en_bbe: Why are you crying for help because of your wound? for your pain may never be taken away: because your evil-doing was so great and because your sins were increased, I have done these things to you.

verses.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
verses.pt: Portanto todos os que te devoram serão devorados, e todos os teus adversários irão, todos eles, para o cativeiro; e os que te roubam serão roubados, e a todos os que te saqueiam entregarei ao saque.
verses.en_web: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, all those who take you for their food will themselves become your food; and all your attackers, every one of them, will be taken prisoners; and those who send destruction on you will come to destruction; and all those who take away your goods by force will undergo the same themselves.

verses.en: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
verses.pt: Pois te restaurarei a saúde e te sararei as feridas, diz o Senhor; porque te chamaram a repudiada, dizendo: É Sião, à qual já ninguém procura.
verses.en_web: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says Yahweh; “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”
verses.en_bbe: For I will make you healthy again and I will make you well from your wounds, says the Lord; because they have given you the name of an outlaw, saying, It is Zion cared for by no man.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que acabarei o cativeiro das tendas de Jacó, e apiedarme-ei das suas moradas; e a cidade será reedificada sobre o seu montão, e o palácio permanecerá como habitualmente.
verses.en_web: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has said, See, I am changing the fate of the tents of Jacob, and I will have pity on his houses; the town will be put up on its hill, and the great houses will be living-places again.

verses.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.pt: E sairá deles ação de graças e a voz dos que se alegram; e multiplicá-los-ei, e não serão diminuídos; glorificá-los-ei, e não serão apoucados.
verses.en_web: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.
verses.en_bbe: And from them will go out praise and the sound of laughing: and I will make them great in number, and they will not become less; and I will give them glory, and they will not be small.

verses.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.pt: E seus filhos serão como na antigüidade, e a sua congregação será estabelecida diante de mim, e castigarei todos os seus opressores.
verses.en_web: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.
verses.en_bbe: And their children will be as they were in the old days, and the meeting of the people will have its place before me, and I will send punishment on all who are cruel to them.

verses.en: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E o seu príncipe será deles, e o seu governador sairá do meio deles; e o farei aproximar, e ele se chegará a mim. Pois quem por si mesmo ousaria chegar-se a mim? diz o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach to me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach to me?” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And their chief will be of their number; their ruler will come from among themselves; and I will let him be present before me, so that he may come near to me: for who may have strength of heart to come near me? says the Lord.

verses.en: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.pt: E vós sereis o meu povo, e eu serei o vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.en: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.pt: Eis a tempestade do Senhor! A sua indignação já saiu, uma tempestade varredora; cairá cruelmente sobre a cabeça dos impios.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm: it will burst on the head of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: See, the storm-wind of the Lord, even the heat of his wrath, has gone out, a rolling storm, bursting on the heads of the evil-doers.

verses.en: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
verses.pt: Não retrocederá o furor da ira do Senhor, até que ele tenha executado, e até que tenha cumprido os desígnios do seu coração. Nos últimos dias entendereis isso.
verses.en_web: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”
verses.en_bbe: The wrath of the Lord will not be turned back till he has done, till he has put into effect, the purposes of his heart: in days to come you will have full knowledge of this.
